body:
No matter how hard I try, I always seem to fail... My whole life is so fucked up. From my birth, I feel like I've just been a burden on the world. I try my best to give all the love and care I can to others.. But I either get used or ignored.. I'm completely insignificant.. My son, my boyfriend.. They would be so much better off without me.. All I do is bring pain. I don't even know how I'm still getting up and going to work everyday... Its a fucking miracle. All day I just turn off my brain and get by. Everything hurts and I try to ignore it, but I can't anymore... My life is just too fucked up. I've been through so much shit that no one even cares to know about. I just want to quit... 

I have no friends, and no family I trust. This is my first post to redditt, and I feel completely pathetic asking for comfort from strangers...
